name: lightdrawer-receipts
description: Prove this file existed, unchanged, at this time — and let anyone check it without trusting us. One receipt ZIP (OpenTimestamps + FreeTSA + certificate-log stamp + optional Rekor) and a single-file offline verifier. Files are hashed in 4 MB chunks.
